description: Address autocomplete (minimum 3 characters). Pass latitude+longitude to bias results and support "near me" / "nearby" category queries (hospital, school, park).

latitude.description: User latitude. Must be sent with longitude.

longitude.description: User longitude. Must be sent with latitude.

query.description: Search query (minimum 3 characters). Supports near-me keywords when latitude and longitude are set.

name: autocomplete
